title: ui-prompt: create ExtractFieldsButton
description: Create the ExtractFieldsButton component that triggers the field extraction process from the user's prompt text. This button initiates parsing and structured data extraction to transform free-form text into actionable planning fields.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL display a clear label indicating the button's extraction function
THE SYSTEM SHALL show a loading state during extraction processing

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user clicks the ExtractFieldsButton
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL initiate the extraction process with the current prompt text
THE SYSTEM SHALL display the extracted fields in the UI

unwanted.condition: IF the prompt textarea is empty
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT trigger the extraction process
unwanted.because: extracting from empty content would waste resources and confuse users

unwanted.condition: IF extraction is already in progress
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT start a new extraction request
unwanted.because: concurrent extractions could cause race conditions and inconsistent state

preconditions: The prompt text must be non-empty before extraction
The extraction service must be available and initialized
postconditions: After successful extraction, structured fields are populated
After failed extraction, an error message is displayed to the user
invariants: Button disabled state always reflects extraction eligibility
Loading indicator is shown only during active extraction

happy: Enter prompt text, click button, verify fields are extracted
Click button with valid prompt and verify loading state appears then resolves
error: Click button with empty prompt and verify it remains disabled
Trigger extraction when service fails and verify error handling

phase_0: Review existing button patterns with loading states
phase_2: Create ExtractFieldsButton component with is_loading, is_disabled, on_click props

similar: See Button component with loading state patterns
